findings: A large hyperdense collection in the left basal ganglia and internal capsule measuring approximately 4.5 cm in maximum diameter, with intraventricular extension filling the lateral and third ventricles. There is surrounding hypodense oedema, effacement of the left lateral ventricle, rightward midline shift of approximately 9 mm and subfalcine herniation. The basal cisterns are compressed. No extra-axial collection is identified.
impression: Large left basal ganglia haemorrhage with intraventricular extension, perilesional oedema, 9 mm midline shift and subfalcine herniation. Obstructive hydrocephalus is threatened by the intraventricular clot.
recommendations: Immediate neurosurgical review. Blood pressure control and reversal of any anticoagulation. Consider CT angiography to exclude a spot sign, and urgent external ventricular drainage if consciousness deteriorates.
